name: GPURealTimeBC6H
definition: GPURealTimeBC6H is a GPU-based real-time compressor for the BC6H texture format. It prunes the search space by restricting the algorithm to specific BC6H block modes tailored for speed or quality presets.
summary: GPURealTimeBC6H is a GPU-based real-time BC6H compressor that optimizes perceptual error by performing arithmetic in log2 space and restricting searches to specific modes.
